name: firearm-misfire-recovery
description: POL-01 / S4 T3, owner decision B. Launch 1 runs disposable-firearm-misfire-recovery: the save-free firearm fixture (native click handler, native commands, native AI brain controller, native completed-rest boundary) with the recovery lanes: Quick Clear then a fresh AI decision and a deliberate stop; out-of-combat Repair Firearm; completed rest after the gun moved to shared inventory and to another participant; failed repair, reload-only and other-firearm negatives; the manual-order control; and the turn-based boundaries.
